headlines.description: Vince Young threw a go-ahead 8-yard touchdown pass to Riley Cooper with 2:45 to play and the undermanned Philadelphia Eagles finally got things right in the fourth quarter, posting a 17-10 victory over the New York Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles overcome injuries, stun Giants in fourth
